Subject: Post-demo: Sherwood Labs - integration notes & repro for 5xx on embedding calls

Hi Alex — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our end: 

- Goal: get embeddings + reranker working reliably in your staging environment and identify the root cause for intermittent 5xx on /v1/embeddings.
- What we saw on the call: successful low-volume embedding calls, but reproducible 5xx (~502/504) under moderate batch sizes and when a metadata array is present.

Next steps (proposed):
1) You share a minimal failing payload + sample log snippet (headers + timestamp).
2) Jasmine (SE) will provide a short SDK-based repro script (node/python) that reproduces locally and in your staging.
3) Sean (support) will look at gateway traces and advise whether this is a routing/gateway issue or model serving.
4) Schedule a 60-min debug session with your infra + our SEs; suggested windows Thu/Fri this week.

I attached an infra diagram that maps call paths we discussed. If you can drop the failing payload into S3 or paste a sanitized snippet in reply that will help us move quickly.

— Soojin

- Timestamp window: 2026-09-14T17:09:43Z -> 17:12:10Z
- Endpoint: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
- Client: sherwood-staging-us-east-1 (node 18)
- Error pattern: 502 with no JSON body (gateway returned blank response body). When we remove the metadata array from the payload the calls succeed.

I pasted a tiny sanitized payload below that fails for us (payload truncated):

{
  "model": "rw-embedding-1.0",
  "input": ["doc1 text...","doc2 text..."],
  "meta": ["tag1","tag2","tag3","tag4","tag5"]
}

We can grant access to the S3 path with full logs if you need it: s3://sherwood-prod/logs/embed-errors/2026-09-14/ (public link in follow-up). We'd like to book Thu 09/16 09:00 - 10:00 PT if that works.

Subject: Re: Post-demo: Sherwood Labs - integration notes & repro for 5xx on embedding calls

Hi Alex — thanks for the payload + logs. A few quick hypotheses and a repro script I recommend you try immediately: 

Hypotheses: 
- The gateway may be rejecting payloads over a certain byte threshold when combined with a metadata array due to a parsing path that materializes a large internal structure.
- Content-Type mismatch (client sending application/json; charset=utf-8 vs our gateway expecting exact header) can sometimes trigger intermediate proxies to return a blank 502.
- SDK client default timeout may be too short for batched embeddings; we recommend explicit timeouts on the request.

Immediate repro (Node, using Redwood SDK):
1) Install @redwoodai/sdk (v0.9.3)
2) Run: node repro-embed.js (we attach a tiny script below)

Minimal repro notes (what to change):
- Set maxBatchSize = 8 and include the meta array exactly as you pasted.
- Set headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } explicitly.
- Increase timeout: client.requestTimeout = 45000 (ms).

If that reproduces we can iterate. If it does not, please upload the failing payload exactly as sent (including headers) — that is the most helpful.

I'll join the Thu slot if you confirm.

— Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Sherwood Labs - integration notes & repro for 5xx on embedding calls

Looping in with support triage notes after a quick look at your S3 logs (thanks for uploading).

What I see: repeated 502 responses coming from the edge gateway (nginx/timeouts) with no upstream body. The edge logs show a "client prematurely closed connection" pattern in a subset of those requests that coincides with higher payload sizes. Two actionable items for us to validate: 

1) Capture a full request/response trace (we'll need your consent to temporarily proxy a single failing request through our capture endpoint). This will show whether the upstream model server returned an error or the gateway dropped the connection.
2) Try Jasmine's repro with explicit Content-Type and a longer client timeout. If we can reproduce locally we can rule out client vs gateway.

Marissa — flagging for prioritization: Sherwood is in evaluation and this impacts their onboarding timeline. Recommend P1 debug slot Thu 09/16 09:00 PT and a post-mortem doc if we confirm a gateway bug.

— Sean Gallagher
Support Engineer, Redwood Inference
